meta.title: Mobile sessions: September versus August 2026
meta.question: How many mobile sessions were there in September versus August?
meta.author: Codex

items: Checks refer to the numbered JSONL evidence logs.
Counts are sessions, including unidentified browsing visits.
Mobile
Sessions recorded as iOS or Android, as confirmed by the user.
Session
A continuous device visit, counted by its start time.

blocks.text: September had 38,365 mobile sessions versus 36,295 in August, an increase of 2,070 (5.7%). Check 3.

items: September had 30 days versus 31 in August. Average daily starts rose from 1,170.8 to 1,278.8 (+9.2%).
Mobile web cannot be identified from the platform field and is excluded.

The count by start is an ad hoc measure, not a registered standalone metric. The registry supporting metrics version is 1.1; its sessions-per-active-user numerator uses a month-overlap rule for identified sessions.
Silver session-grain detail preserves all visits. Gold platform summaries count active users rather than sessions.
The two platform increases account for the total change arithmetically; this does not establish why usage changed.
The user requested a count comparison, so a causal investigation was not performed.
Checks 3-5: IDs are distinct within each month and platform; Bronze and Silver counts agree. Sessions occur on every day in both months. No ambiguous resolutions or mismatched links in those months.
Unidentified mobile sessions included: 2,645 in August and 2,849 in September.
One iOS session started in August and continued into September. Counting sessions touching a month gives 36,295 and 38,366, respectively (check 6).
The documented activity coverage is April 1 through October 1, 2026, exclusive, but is not independently declared in database metadata.

The stored build was successful and reports source/session reconciliation. Its registry SHA-256 differs from the current repository registry; the builder hash matches. The counts are directly reconciled with Bronze but registry equivalence and build freshness have not been independently established.

Snapshot time is the database metadata user snapshot, not a verified file hash or proof of freshness. The repository is a download without Git metadata; directory creation timestamp is November 9, 2026 20:12:48 IST, used as an approximate download date.
Web includes 9,946 August and 10,349 September sessions with no mobile-device classification in the available platform field.
Confirm whether mobile web is required and obtain device classification if so.
Use the same session-start convention for future comparisons and monitor daily averages as well as totals.
